description: This file is a PHP source code implementing an interface to Jira REST API for issue tracking within a testing framework. It initializes configuration, establishes connection to Jira, and performs sample API calls to retrieve issue types, priorities, versions, and components.

classes.name: jirarestInterface
classes.description: A class that interfaces with Jira REST API, providing methods for connection checking, and retrieving issue types, priorities, versions, and components.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to Jira API is active.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns an API client object for further API interactions.

methods.name: getIssueTypes
methods.description: Fetches available issue types from Jira.

methods.name: getIssueTypesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Fetches issue types formatted for HTML select elements.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves versions for a specified project.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components for a specified project.
